test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Nothing can be achieved without hard work.

options.text: One has achieved nothing without hard work.
One will achieve nothing without hard work.
One could achieve nothing without hard work.
One can achieve nothing without hard work.

solution:
The correct answer is **One can achieve nothing without hard work.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The modal verb **'****can'** is used in the given sentence. 
 
• To change sentences having present/future modals into passive voice, the auxiliary verb “be” is added after the modal in the sentence.
 
• Sentence structure: 
 
 
• Active: Subject + can + V1 + Object
 
• Passive: Object + can + be V3 + by + Subject
 
 
 
• ​The places of subject and object in a sentence are** inter-changed** while converting from active to passive voice and vice-versa.
 
• The first step for converting passive voice into active voice is to **find the action of the sentence**.
 
• The next step is to **find the subject and place it before the verb**.
 
• Here, the **verb** is** 'achieve'** and the subject is not specified, thus,** 'one' **will be used as** the subject. **
 
• The next step is to** put the object after the verb.**
 
• In the given context** object **is **nothing.**
 
• **​**Hence, the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice is **option 4**.
 
• The active voice of the given sentence is **'****One can achieve nothing without hard work.'**
